subject: Acme procurement: PO vs Card & marketplace interest
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Acme procurement: PO vs Card & marketplace interest

Hi Dana — great to meet you on the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Summary of discovery:
- Primary use: internal customer support assistants and targeted knowledge bases (docs + ticket history).
- Expected monthly token volume: ~150M tokens with burst windows.
- Security: Acme requires SOC2 + audit logs; you mentioned wanting data residency in us-east.

Procurement / commercial questions we flagged on the call:
1) Payment preference: do you require a Purchase Order and invoice billing, or is card acceptable for initial POC?
2) Marketplace: are you interested in buying via Azure/GCP marketplace to simplify procurement?
3) Contract & SOW: will your legal team want a custom SOW or can we proceed with our standard SOW + redlines?

Next steps (owner):
- I shared the draft SOW and pricing deck (attached) — please confirm reviewers (Marissa).
- Please let us know PO header requirements and timeline (Dana).
- I'll follow up next Wednesday for a quick procurement check-in if we haven't heard back (Marissa).

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_deck_v3.pdf, SOW_Redwood-Acme_draft.docx

Thanks again — happy to jump on a short call with procurement/legal if that helps move things along.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first LLM inference.

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Lee <kevin.lee@acme.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme procurement: PO vs Card & marketplace interest

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement/legal: 

- Payment: Acme standard is PO + invoice (net 30). We generally avoid corporate card for anything beyond an initial $5k POC. For a production commitment at the volumes we discussed, we'll need PO/invoice.
- Marketplace: yes — buying via Azure Marketplace is preferred because it saves a lot of internal approvals. If Redwood can support marketplace billing, that would be ideal.
- SOW/Contract: Our legal will want to redline the SOW and the contract. Please send the clean SOW and the Master Services Agreement (if you have one).

I've looped in Kevin (Legal) who will be the primary reviewer for the contract side — Kevin, we received the SOW and pricing from Redwood; can you confirm timeline for review?

Also: PO header details — Acme requires vendor legal name, remit address, and invoice email. I'll pull a template and attach.

Thanks,
Dana Liu
Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
dana.liu@acme.com
